rows.name: Bashing Finish
rows.description: You follow a powerful blow from your weapon with an opportunistic bash from your shield.

rows.name: Bloody Assault
rows.description: Sacrificing accuracy, you can inflict bloody wounds that are slow to heal.

rows.name: Bodyguard
rows.description: Your swift strikes ward off enemies attacking nearby allies.

rows.name: Bull Rush Strike
rows.description: Your critical hits can push back your foes.

rows.name: Charge Through
rows.description: You can overrun enemies when charging.

rows.name: Cockatrice Strike
rows.description: With a single strike, you transmute flesh to stone.

rows.name: Combat Patrol
rows.description: You range across the battlefield, dealing with threats wherever they arise.

rows.name: Coordinated Defense
rows.description: You are adept at working with allies to avoid being tripped, grappled, and subjected to other maneuvers.

rows.name: Coordinated Maneuvers
rows.description: You are skilled at working with your allies to perform dangerous combat maneuvers.

rows.name: Covering Defense
rows.description: You are skilled at protecting yourself and your allies with your shield.

rows.name: Crippling Critical
rows.description: You are able to maim a target and hinder its movement.

rows.name: Crossbow Mastery
rows.description: You can load crossbows with blinding speed and even fire them in melee with little fear of reprisal.

rows.name: Dastardly Finish
rows.description: You can take advantage of an enemy's debilitated state to attempt a coup de grace.

rows.name: Dazing Assault
rows.description: You can daze foes with wild attacks.

rows.name: Disarming Strike
rows.description: Your critical hits can disarm your foes.

rows.name: Disrupting Shot
rows.description: With a well-placed shot, you make it harder for a nearby opponent to cast spells.

rows.name: Dreadful Carnage
rows.description: Slaying an enemy demoralizes your other nearby foes.

rows.name: Eldritch Claws
rows.description: Who needs magic weapons? Eldritch tricks are no match for your bestial ferocity.

rows.name: Elemental Fist
rows.description: You empower your strike with elemental energy

rows.name: Elemental Fist
rows.description: You empower your strike with elemental energy

rows.name: Elven Accuracy
rows.description: Your sharp eyesight makes difficult shots easier.

rows.name: Enforcer
rows.description: You are skilled at causing fear in those you brutalize.

rows.name: Focused Shot
rows.description: Your anatomical insight adds deadliness to your shots.

rows.name: Following Step
rows.description: You can repeatedly close the distance when foes try to move away, without impeding your normal movement.

rows.name: Furious Focus
rows.description: Even in the midst of fierce and furious blows, you can find focus in the carnage and your seemingly wild blows strike home.

rows.name: Gang Up
rows.description: You are adept at using greater numbers against foes.

rows.name: Greater Blind-Fight
rows.description: Your enemies cannot hide from you.

rows.name: Greater Dirty Trick
rows.description: When you pull a dirty trick, your foe is truly hindered.

rows.name: Greater Drag
rows.description: Foes that you drag around are thrown out of balance.

rows.name: Greater Reposition
rows.description: When you reposition foes, they are left vulnerable to attacks of your allies.

rows.name: Greater Shield Specialization
rows.description: Your masterful shieldwork provides even greater protection to your vital areas.

rows.name: Greater Steal
rows.description: You have a knack for snatching items from your opponent in combat.

rows.name: Improved Blind-Fight
rows.description: Your keen senses guide your hand against hidden foes.

rows.name: Improved Dirty Trick
rows.description: You are skilled at pulling dirty tricks on your foes.

rows.name: Improved Drag
rows.description: You are skilled at dragging foes around the battlefield

rows.name: Improved Ki Throw
rows.description: Your enemies are living weapons in your hands.

rows.name: Improved Reposition
rows.description: You have learned how to force your enemies to move around the battlefield.

rows.name: Improved Second Chance
rows.description: You can turn a missed strike into a second chance without sacrificing later attacks.

rows.name: Improved Sidestep
rows.description: You are adept at sidestepping your opponent's melee attacks without compromising your mobility.

rows.name: Improved Steal
rows.description: You have a knack for snatching items from your opponents.

rows.name: In Harm's Way
rows.description: You put yourself in danger's path to save your allies.

rows.name: Ki Throw
rows.description: Your physical control and mastery of momentum allows you to throw enemies.

rows.name: Lookout
rows.description: Your allies help you avoid being surprised.

rows.name: Low Profile
rows.description: Your small stature helps you avoid ranged attacks.

rows.name: Missile Shield
rows.description: You are skilled at deflecting ranged attacks with your shield.

rows.name: Mounted Shield
rows.description: Your defensive tactics defend both you and your mount.

rows.name: Mounted Skirmisher
rows.description: You are adept at attacking from upon a swift moving steed.

rows.name: Outflank
rows.description: You look for every edge when flanking an enemy.

rows.name: Paired Opportunists
rows.description: You know how to make an enemy pay for lax defenses.

rows.name: Parting Shot
rows.description: You are an expert skirmisher, able to rain missiles upon your enemies whether advancing or retreating.

rows.name: Perfect Strike
rows.description: When wielding a monk weapon, your attacks can be extremely precise.

rows.name: Point Blank Master
rows.description: You are adept at firing ranged weapons in close quarters.

rows.name: Practiced Tactician
rows.description: With only a few quick gestures and commands, you can direct others in combat.

rows.name: Precise Strike
rows.description: You are skilled at striking where it counts, as long as an ally distracts your foe.

rows.name: Punishing Kick
rows.description: Your kicks are so powerful you use them to push or knock back.

rows.name: Pushing Assault
rows.description: A strike made with a two-handed weapon can push a similar sized opponent backward.

rows.name: Ray Shield
rows.description: You can even deflect rays with your shield.

rows.name: Rending Claws
rows.description: Your claw attacks do greater harm to your enemy.

rows.name: Repositioning Strike
rows.description: Your critical hits can move your foes where you wish.

rows.name: Saving Shield
rows.description: You def lect attacks that could mean your ally's death.

rows.name: Second Chance
rows.description: Quick reflexes turn missed strikes into second chances.

rows.name: Shadow Strike
rows.description: You accurately strike even those you cannot clearly see.

rows.name: Shield of Swings
rows.description: A wild frenzy of attacks serves to bolster your defenses.

rows.name: Shield Specialization
rows.description: You have mastered the use of one type of shield.

rows.name: Shield Wall
rows.description: You form a unified defense with those around you.

rows.name: Sidestep
rows.description: You can reposition yourself after a foe's missed swing.

rows.name: Smash
rows.description: You overcome obstacles by breaking them.

rows.name: Stabbing Shot
rows.description: You can clear the way to continue using your bow.

rows.name: Step Up and Strike
rows.description: When a foe tries to move away, you can follow and make an attack.

rows.name: Stunning Assault
rows.description: You powerful but imprecise attacks can stun your enemies.

rows.name: Sundering Strike
rows.description: Your critical hits can sunder your foes' weapons.

rows.name: Swap Places
rows.description: You are skilled at changing places with your ally during a chaotic melee.

rows.name: Swift Aid
rows.description: With a quick but harmless swipe, you can aid an ally's assault.

rows.name: Team Up
rows.description: When you are ganging up against an enemy, you can aid an ally with a quick feint.

rows.name: Teleport Tactician
rows.description: You are highly alert for enemies using teleportation to approach you or flee from you.

rows.name: Touch of Serenity
rows.description: With a single touch you can reduce the threat of even the most savage of foes.

rows.name: Trick Riding
rows.description: You are not only skilled at controlling a horse in combat; you can make it look like art.

rows.name: Tripping Strike
rows.description: The force intrinsic to your critical hits can knock your foes down.

rows.name: Under and Over
rows.description: You can slip under a foe trying to grab you, knocking him off balance.

rows.name: Underfoot
rows.description: You slip under and around your larger foes.
